The '''Imperial-class Repulsor Tank Mark II''' was a model of [[Hovertank/Legends|repulsortank]] employed by the [[Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit/Legends|Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit]] around [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]]. Physically similar in design to the [[S-1 FireHawke Heavy Repulsortank]] rather than its [[Imperial-class repulsortank|Imperial-class]] predecessor, the Mark II was capable of reaching speeds of 400 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]]. It was armed with a heavy [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] with maximum range of five kilometers, and a medium laser cannon with a maximum range of one kilometer.<ref name="J15" />
